Parameters ---------- name : str The user’s display name. bio : str A potentially multi‑sentence biography. May contain user supplied characters that need to be escaped. status_msg : str A short status message or one‑liner. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the user data safely escaped to avoid XSS. Notes ----- The function uses :func:`html.escape` to neutralise any HTML special characters in the user input. This protects against CWE‑79 (Cross‑Site Scripting) by ensuring that no injected markup can be executed when the resulting string is inserted into a page. Examples -------- >>> show_user_profile('Alice', 'Hello ', 'Enjoying coding!') "

" """ # Escape user input to prevent HTML injection safe_name = html.escape(name, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(bio, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status_msg, quote=True) # Render the template with the sanitized values return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status_msg=safe_status )
